craft_notes: Sthāyin: centrality by overstepping. Rows: leap then reach. Read aloud: ascent.

lines: As, as the shade is to o'erleap — being, before, before, it stands —
so to the Highest's mid-point arrival: being o'er all is middle-hood — so said.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yathā yathā ca svacchāyā laṅghayitum iṣṭā satī puraḥ puro bhavati tathā parameśvaramadhyatām eti sarvādhiṣṭhātṛtaiva mādhyasthyam ity uktam
